text: I can draw the closed, open and half-open state machine and say what triggers each of its transitions.
I can explain why a breaker without a half-open state flaps against a recovering service, and how half-open trials prevent it.
I can choose a failure-rate threshold, window, minimum call count and open duration for a dependency, and estimate how long the breaker takes to trip given the timeout.
I can say when per-host outlier detection is the right tool instead of a service-wide breaker, and how Envoy's circuit breaking differs from the application pattern.
I can pick a fallback for each dependency, state its staleness and cost, and decide when failing fast with an honest error is better.
I can design alerts on breaker state and fallback rate so a fallback never hides an outage.
